text: i’ve noticed i haven’t felt much in my chest lately, not for the past few months. nowadays it’s always my stomach or my head. occasionally with the right song i can still feel a brief moment of mania, but it’s often brief. maybe i need to stand up straighter.

it's almost thanksgiving, and religion has been on my mind, though it's always been on my mind lately. last time i had many thoughts on religion in its context, with community. in this past half year ive started going back to church relatively consistently, and new thoughts have surfaced, albeit in a much less organized manner. nonetheless.

ive been finding church a satisfying solitary experience lately, and i think my views on religion have gone increasingly individualized.
